notes: One prompt, one build, 8 of 8. Base44 created the backend entities itself (Booking with create/list) and ran its own end-to-end check in the editor. The app was only reachable after clicking Publish — before that the public URL answered 'This app is not available yet'. The subdomain is auto-generated (inescapable-still-point-flow.base44.app); Base44 suggests buying stillpointbooking.com. Email delivery requires a paid plan and a verified domain and the confirmation screen says so explicitly. Same limitation as Lovable, same pass under A6.

criterion_notes.A9: Follow-up prompt changed the 90-minute price from $130 to $120; booking form, reference and admin ledger still worked afterwards.

retest.note: Applied in one build. Public app shows $90/$120/$150, the session dropdown reads $120, a test booking returned reference SP-98VPKW and the admin list shows it with the new price. Publishing required an explicit Publish click.
